label: F-01
title: Story 103 contradicts itself: its Background cutover sequence (L59-71) and step-0 precondition (L150), plus BalancerWinddownPlan.md Stage 2, still prescribe the superseded OWNER-EOA custody flow that the 2026-10-07 / 2026-10-10 amendments forbid
rootCause: Amendments appended without marking the superseded sections; source plan not updated.
description: The same story's Background 'Cutover sequence' (L59-71) still gives the superseded EOA flow: step 2 `withdrawBPT(OWNER, fullBalance)`; step 3 'Exit the OWNER's whole BPT balance'; step 4 'addLiquidity ... from the owner; this creates the pair'; step 9 'USDS dust sweep'. Technical Details L150 still has the step-0 'pair absence or (0,0) reserves' precondition. The source plan Stage 2 (docs/BalancerWinddownPlan.md:376-428) also still prescribes OWNER custody: `skim(OWNER)`, `withdrawBPT(OWNER, fullBalance)`, parked USDS 'rescueERC20(USDS, OWNER, fullBalance)', and the griefing-recovery text 'the recovered sUSDS and phUSD sit on OWNER'. The landed core (story 100, which predates the requirement) implements exactly that flow: UniPoolerCutoverCore.sol:341, :362, :373, :425-430, :521. The authoritative incomplete story contradicts itself, and its named source plan contradicts its latest requirement. An executor reading top-down meets the EOA flow first. The commit/plan text claims an order and a custody model that the story no longer asks for.
impact: No Law-1 exploit: EOA custody by a trusted owner is not an attack path. The value at stake is the accounting and tax provability the human asked for, plus the risk that 103 ships an un-rewired core.
assetImpact: None directly; the risk is that story 103 ships the superseded OWNER-EOA flow (which makes DEDUP-001 live) because the story's top-down Background (L59-71, L150) and plan Stage 2 contradict the 2026-10-07/10-10 amendments.
recommendation: Before 103 executes, mark Background L59-71 and L150 as superseded by the 2026-10-07/10-10 amendments (as story 100 L52 did), and add an escrow-flow note to plan §4 Stage 2.

classification.justification: A pure Law-2 internal contradiction in an incomplete story and its source plan. No security impact of its own, because EOA custody by a trusted owner is not an attack path. It is the documentary root that would turn DEDUP-001 (L-01) from latent into live, so it is reported visibly as F-01 at QA-equivalent severity, never bundled into gas noise.
